:::{.content-hidden when-format='docx'}

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
ID <- "CAV"
.buildComponent <- function(component) {
  DIR <- component
  if (!ID %in% c("AI", "CAV", "CAV5")) {
    stop("IM.R supports only AI, CAV, and CAV5.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  Column <- paste(ID, DIR, sep = ".")
  if (!Column %in% names(TSWTable)) {
    stop(sprintf("Missing cumulative TS column: %s", Column), call. = FALSE)
  }
  Label <- if (ID == "AI") "IA" else ID

  SRS <- TSWTable[, .(
    ID    = RecordID,
    X     = t,
    Y     = get(Column),
    style = "ShortDashDot",
    size  = THIN_LINE_SIZE
  )][is.finite(X) & is.finite(Y)][order(ID, X)]
  source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "IM.R"), local = TRUE)
  PLOT
}
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width }

#### H1

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false
DIR <- "H1"
PLOT <- .buildComponent(DIR)
```
